note: Named scenarios (SCOPE.md E15, IDEAS.md 5): a scenario is a release plus overrides of the settings of one or both presets. results/scenarios.csv is generated from this file by web/scripts/make-scenarios.mjs. A scenario changes settings the model already has; it is not a method change (those are modules, methods/) and it is not a forecast. The reference scenario is the release's own defaults.

scenarios.label: Reference: the improved method on the 2025 data at its defaults
Avoidable food waste at the national target (halved to 6%)
scenarios.source: National Food Waste Strategy (2017) and Roadmap (FIAL 2020): halve food waste across the chain by 2030. The setting scales the thesis's retail and consumer losses together (analysis/waste_2025/README.md, analysis/loss_factors_2025/README.md); the long-term default is the thesis's frugal 0%, so this scenario is a worse long-term case than the default

scenarios.label: No avoidable food waste
scenarios.source: End of the waste ladder (analysis/waste_2025/): the upper bound of what waste reduction can add in the short term

scenarios.label: No recycling of food waste into animal feed
scenarios.source: The recycling setting is the share achieved of the stage uptake pattern of the period (methods/recycling-stage; analysis/waste_2025/README_stages.md)

scenarios.label: Half of the stage uptake pattern achieved
Long term: light vehicles electrified, 156 litres of liquid fuel a person
scenarios.source: analysis/fuel_sectors_2025/ (Table F, thesis sector method with light vehicles electrified); release 2025-fuel-ev

scenarios.label: Long term: biofuel at CSIRO's maximum feedstock, 340 litres a person
scenarios.source: analysis/liquid_fuel_2025/ (CSIRO biofuel tables: maximum feedstock about 340 to 365 litres a person). The total residual liquid fuel need in 2050 is 840 to 1,700 litres a person, so this is a ceiling for the land, not a supply of the need

scenarios.label: Long term: one year of grain held in store (the store is free in the model)
scenarios.source: analysis/resilience_2025/README.md section 6; an upper bound because the store costs no land and has no losses (DISCUSSION.md row 4)

scenarios.label: Long term: two years of grain held in store (the store is free in the model)
